summary: PR-1593 adds the payee account number to the statement-delivery failure log in payments' service.py. The logger masks fields by name and account_number is a registered NPI field, so only a masked last four digits can be logged and LOG-1 holds; a passing unit test checks this exact field. The ticket, independent approval of the head commit, and passing full CI run with control tests satisfy the process obligations, and no security-sensitive or protected paths are touched. The LOG-1 control test is only a sample and does not run the new failure path, so LOG-1 rests on the name-based masking argument rather than on that test.
